name: telecom-defense-monitoring
description: Stand up StaticZero telecom defense monitoring in a lab: read-only platform preflight (telecom_doctor), start the defense daemon with the telecom-detect module group as a managed background process (telecom_defense_start, requires logs_dir), query the running engine's HTTP API for correlated threats and raw alerts, then stop the daemon via its process id. The daemon requires root and kernel >= 5.15. Defensive playbook: no MITRE ATT&CK techniques apply.

vars.name: logs_dir
vars.description: Directory for daemon output: SIEM JSON-lines alerts (staticzero-defense-<id>.jsonl) and stderr logs (staticzero-defense-<id>.err); created with 0700 if missing

vars.name: base_url
vars.description: Base URL of the defense engine HTTP API
